tooltips.code: 3–24 characters: A–Z, 0–9 and a dash. Saved in upper case.
tooltips.value: Percent: 1–100. Fixed: EUR above 0 (never more than the order total).
tooltips.usedCount: Server-owned: goes up when the order is completed.
tooltips.perCustomerLimit: How many times one customer may use the code. 0 = unlimited.
tooltips.minAmount: Order lines total before the discount. 0 = no minimum.
tooltips.firstVisitOnly: Only for a customer with no completed order yet.
